content:
arjun: Quick spike result: prototype estimator can produce a per-route delta in ~120ms for sampled previews. Thinking we add a Console 'Dry-run preview' before committing staged overrides.
maria: Nice. What does the preview show exactly?
arjun: Diff of the config + metrics delta: qps change, p50/p95 latency delta, token-cost delta (bucketed), cache-hit delta, and an uncertainty/confidence interval. Also a short list of top example traces (hashed ids).
kevin: Requirements: (1) cheap estimator for instant preview, (2) optional heavy replay that runs against routing-audit logs for precise numbers, (3) quota & billing for heavy jobs.
sophie: UX: default to cheap estimator with sampling metadata. Show sample size and a confidence band. Make heavy replay an explicit action and warn about cost/time.
rachel: Important: preflight gate. If preview shows p95 up >25% for routes with >50 qps, block rollout unless an override is approved. We need an ops-approval flow.
maria: Also add an "auto-rollback candidate" flag in the preview when risk is high. That wires into rollout pipeline so if live telemetry crosses the simulated threshold we auto-roll back.
arjun: Implementation sketch for internal API:
POST /internal/configs/dry-run
Headers: X-Preview-Project, X-Preview-Budget (optional)
Body: {
  "config_id": "cfg_2026_01",
  "scope": {"routes": ["/v1/generate", "/v1/chat"]},
  "time_window": "2026-03-20T00:00:00Z/2026-03-21T00:00:00Z",
  "sampling": 0.001,
  "mode": "quick" // "quick" or "replay"
}

Response (quick): {
  "job_id": "dryrun_abc",
  "status": "done",
  "estimates": {
    "per_route": [{"route": "/v1/generate", "qps_delta": "-0.2%", "p95_delta_ms": "+12", "token_cost_delta": "+$3.45/day"}],
    "confidence": "95%",
    "sample_size": 12000
  },
  "flags": ["suggested-auto-rollback"]
}

ops-bot: [automated] Replay mode will consume preview budget and enqueue a replay job. Use X-Preview-Budget to route billing.
audit-bot: [automated] Dry-run reports are retained for 30 days and linked to config changes for compliance.
kevin: For cost estimates -> use model cost profiles + route-specific token-length distribution from metrics store. That gives a reasonable quick estimate.
sophie: For replay mode we replay routing decisions (not raw payload) to compute exact route assignment and then use recorded token-length histograms to recompute costs. This avoids replaying full user payloads.
maria: Privacy: any example traces must be hashed with per-org salt and truncated. UI should never show raw user identifiers.
arjun: On the UI side: diff panel (inline config changes), metric bands, top-3 risky routes, example traces collapsed by default, JSON export button for runbooks, and a 'run heavy replay' CTA.
rachel: Operational note: set default sampling to 0.1% for org-wide rollouts, 1% for per-route smaller rollouts. Make sampling configurable per-team.
kevin: Edge-case: when route-level cache hit-rate is stale. Estimator should surface cache-uncertainty and recommend running replay.
sophie: Telemetry gating rule proposal: if quick-estimate p95 delta > 15% AND simulated affected users > 1% then block. Override requires two approvers and a short justification.
maria: I'll paper the RFC: API shapes, storage lifecycle, default sampling, retention, and the ops approval flow. @arjun can you attach prototype latency numbers and the quick-estimator algorithm?
arjun: Yep, will attach run results and a short script to reproduce. Plan: prototype UI widget in canary console next week.
kevin: tiny ask: add a small 'uncertainty' icon with hover text explaining assumptions (model profiles, recent hit rates, sample size).
sophie: +1. Also add a link to the 'how to interpret previews' docs from Console.
arjun: Thanks — I'll open the RFC and create a draft PR for the API and estimator.
ops-bot: [automated] Dry-run endpoints are restricted to internal teams until RBAC is finalized.
maria: Great thread. We'll sync in the weekly rollout sync to finalize gates.
